FAQ

Common questions

How long does local SEO take? ▾
For most Illinois businesses, you’ll see initial ranking movement within 60–90 days and meaningful traffic at 3–6 months. Local SEO compounds — it gets stronger every month.
How many city pages do you build? ▾
We typically start with your 10–25 highest-priority cities and scale from there. Our current clients have city pages covering all of Illinois.
What’s the difference between local SEO and regular SEO? ▾
Local SEO targets location-based searches (‘digital marketing agency Chicago’) and optimizes for the Google Maps pack. It’s faster to rank for than national keywords and converts better because searchers have local intent.
Do you need my website login? ▾
Yes, we need WP admin access (or equivalent) to deploy pages directly. We use the REST API to minimize site risk during deployment.
Can you rank me in cities where I don’t have a physical office? ▾
Yes. Service-area businesses can rank in cities beyond their physical location using city-specific landing pages and a properly configured Google Business Profile. This is exactly what we build.
